description: Hand resolution of the 9 item-review verdicts that said keep but keyCorrect=false (lead review of tools/items-review-all, 2 Nov 2026). Each problem was worked by hand; a keep applies no change, so these needed a decision. items-apply now treats such a verdict as needing a manual decision unless its id is listed here.

items.rubric: kept: it already explains the corrected key (chords lie on or above the graph)
items.working: Convex: f(tx+(1-t)y) <= t f(x) + (1-t) f(y), so the chord lies on or above the graph (option a); option c describes a concave function.
An omitted 900 credit leaves debits 900 above credits. A credit posted as a debit gives 1,800; an omitted debit gives the opposite gap; a wrong expense account leaves totals balanced.
Data enters Q2 and shifts toward Q0: 000 -> 100 -> 110 -> 011 (Q2Q1Q0). Shifting the other way gives 001 -> 011 -> 110, as the rubric says.
DFS from A, smallest unvisited neighbour first: A, B, D, then C (before E), backtrack to D, then E: A, B, D, C, E. A, B, C, D, E is the BFS order.
Bernoulli, horizontal pipe: dp = 0.5 x 1000 x (6^2 - 2^2) = 16,000 Pa = 16 kPa.
300 || 600 = 200 ohm; total 300 ohm; I = 40 mA; the pair drops 8 V; 8 V / 300 ohm = 26.7 mA.
Formulas start with an equals sign in Excel and Google Sheets; #, @ and & do not start a formula.
1,000,000 x 2 KB = 2 GB per day; x 365 = about 730 GB per year.
